name: com.ryanxuwei.hybrid-live-preview
description: Press Play in the Unity Editor and preview your game in Chrome the way a WebGL build would run: the 3D view streams over WebRTC, your own HTML/CSS/JS UI sits on top, and mouse, keyboard and touch input flow back into Unity.

samples.description: Screen reader layer for uGUI: buttons, images and text become real HTML elements over the game (Tab, Enter, NVDA/VoiceOver), plus spoken subtitles. Works in the Play preview and the WebGL build.

A parent page embeds the Unity page with <iframe> and talks to Unity through HybridBridge (postMessage relay, same-origin by default, origin checks, embedding guard). The game state stays in Unity; both pages only show it.
